Its existing three-panel landscape schematic is the clearest statement of that message and maps each error to a different estimator family. Reusing the unaltered figure preserves the original conceptual comparisons and avoids replacing scientific information with decoration.
covers.alt_en: Three sources of hidden-tail TVT error: datum offset, stratigraphic-mode ambiguity, and shape or slope error.

covers.title: ROGII Working Note (Part 2): Error Anatomy of Target-Free TVT Geosteering

covers.rationale: The article frames TVT recovery as target-free stratigraphic alignment rather than independent row regression. This existing sparse landscape figure directly shows horizontal gamma-ray motifs matched to a vertical typewell, including a missing-data gap. It conveys the central physical signal more clearly at cover size than the dense full pipeline overview. The entire body figure is reused without crop, redraw, or data alteration.
covers.alt_en: Gamma-ray motifs from the horizontal well are aligned with a vertical typewell to infer hidden TVT coordinates.
